mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.visible, m.keep_alive, m.redirect, m.perms, m.menu_type, m.order_num, m.status FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = '0' ORDER BY m.order_num ASC, m.menu_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.visible, m.keep_alive, m.redirect, m.perms, m.menu_type, m.order_num, m.status FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('D', 'C') AND m.status = '0' ORDER BY m.order_num ASC, m.menu_id ASC

SELECT menu_id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_id IN
#{id}
